statement_corrected: The new half-range-leverage L3 theorem was described as conditionally paying a subbranch of the surviving account03/B08 r20 two-sided near-coloop state.
correction: In that surviving state both a left and a right ridge leverage are >0.99. Since K_g=HH^T(g^2I+HH^T)^(-1) satisfies 0<=K_g<=Proj(range H), the corresponding physical range-projection diagonals are also >0.99. Thus the max-range-leverage<=1/2 hypothesis cannot occur there. The theorem remains valid in other diffuse-range branches but does not narrow r20.
